propositions: 344 closed bugs exist in the tracker but no aggregated lens answers trend questions: close_class distribution over time, detection channel, bug age, caused_by fan-in, and time-to-close — today answered only via ad-hoc scripts.

Pre-convention bugs (~214) lack close_class field; the lens must surface this era skew as an explicit MISSING labeled cohort alongside vocabulary classes, never silently dropping or merging historical data.
The detected_by field is sparse (not yet populated in production); the lens must degrade that dimension gracefully to unavailable state without crashing or affecting other dimensions.

FLOW dimensions (close_class-by-month, time-to-close) respect the ctx since/until range and filter on close transition timestamp; STOCK dimensions (age percentiles, detected_by distribution, caused_by fan-in) are point-in-time and deliberately ignore range, a deviation from sibling metrics that must be documented.

The lens must register via the standard registry pattern (register() appends specs idempotently on id) and pass edge cases: zero bugs returns unavailable state per convention, mixed-era stores surface MISSING cohort, and all five dimensions are independently testable.
